title: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised…
description: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised, affecting the trust of certificates used by HCL Notes Client for outbound network requests. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated network attacker to spoof server certificates and perform man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks, potentially intercepting or modifying outbound TLS traffic.
